info.title: BCC Showcase Wall API
info.description:
RESTful API & WebSocket contract for **BCC Showcase Wall**.

### Current Implementation Status
- **Implemented & Live (`Auth` & `Health`)**: `/health`, `/api/v1/auth/register`, `/api/v1/auth/login`, `/api/v1/auth/otp/verify`, `/api/v1/auth/otp/resend`, `/api/v1/auth/oauth/firebase`, `/api/v1/auth/refresh`, `/api/v1/auth/logout`, `/api/v1/me`.
- **Planned Contract (`Works`, `Media`, `Admin`)**: Matches Section 7 of the Frontend PRD and the Backend Spec.

### WebSocket Contract (`WS /ws/wall`)
- **URL**: `wss://group4-be.bccdev.id/ws/wall` (or `ws://localhost:8080/ws/wall`)
- **Access**: Public, read-only (server ignores client messages except pong; checks `Origin: https://group4.bccdev.id`).
- **Envelope**: `{ "type": string, "seq": number, "payload": object }`
- **Events**:
  - `work.published`: `{ "id", "title", "summary", "category", "tech_stack", "team_members", "cover_url", "published_at" }`
  - `work.unpublished`: `{ "id": "uuid-karya" }`
  - `work.deleted`: `{ "id": "uuid-karya" }`

post.description: Validates `name` (2-100 chars), `email`, and `password` (8-72 bytes), stores a pending registration in Redis for 10 minutes, and sends a 6-digit OTP code via Resend. Rate-limited to 20 requests/hour per IP and 1 code/min, 5 codes/hour per email.

post.summary: Start Login with Email & Password (Send OTP)
post.description: Verifies email and password in constant time (5 failed logins per 15m per email lock), then sends a 6-digit OTP code to the user's email. Note: OAuth-only users without a password receive the same generic 401 response.

202.description: Credentials valid; OTP code sent to email

post.description: Verifies the 6-digit OTP code (valid 10m, max 5 attempts, single use). On `purpose: "register"`, creates the Contributor account. Returns `access_token` + `user` in JSON and sets the `HttpOnly` `refresh_token` cookie.

409.description: Email was registered by another request while OTP was pending (`email_taken`)

422.description: Invalid/expired OTP (`invalid_code`), max attempts exceeded (`code_attempts_exceeded`), or invalid input (`validation_failed`)

error.message: Terlalu banyak percobaan, minta kode baru

fields.code: Terlalu banyak percobaan, minta kode baru

post.description: Issues a new 6-digit OTP code and resets attempt count if a pending step exists. Always returns `202 Accepted` when within rate limits so callers cannot probe account state.

202.description: New OTP code dispatched if pending step exists

post.summary: Sign In / Sign Up with Firebase OAuth (Google)
post.description:
Exchanges a Firebase ID Token (`id_token`) obtained on the frontend for a backend session (`access_token` + `HttpOnly` `refresh_token` cookie) without requiring an email OTP code.

**Account Resolution Rules:**
- **Returning OAuth User**: Matched by `firebase_uid`.
- **Existing Local User (Unlinked)**: Automatically links `firebase_uid` to the existing account and sets `auth_provider = "both"`.
- **New Email**: Creates user with `password_hash = NULL`, `auth_provider = "google"`, and role `Admin` if email is in `ADMIN_EMAILS`/`ADMIN_EMAIL`, else `Contributor`.
- **Conflict**: If the email is already linked to a different `firebase_uid`, returns `409 oauth_account_conflict`.

401.description: Invalid or expired Firebase ID token (`invalid_id_token`)

error.message: Token Google tidak valid atau sudah kedaluwarsa
Email Anda belum diverifikasi oleh penyedia login

409.description: Email is already linked to a different Google account (`oauth_account_conflict`)

error.message: Email ini sudah tertaut ke akun Google lain

503.description: Firebase credentials not configured on server (`oauth_unavailable`)

post.summary: Rotate Refresh Token & Issue New Access Token
post.description: Reads the `refresh_token` HttpOnly cookie, rotates the session in PostgreSQL, sets a new `refresh_token` cookie, and returns a new 15-minute `access_token`. Presenting a previously rotated token revokes the entire session family (`invalid_session`).

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked, or reused refresh token (`invalid_session`); clears cookie

error.message: Sesi tidak valid, silakan masuk kembali

post.description: Revokes the current session family in PostgreSQL and clears the `refresh_token` cookie.

post.description: Creates a new work with status `Draft` using `multipart/form-data`. `tech_stack` and `team_members` are sent as repeated form fields (`formData.append('tech_stack', item)`).

post.summary: Publish a Draft or Unpublished Work (Admin)
post.description: Transitions a `Draft` or `Unpublished` work to `Published`, sets `published_at`, invalidates Redis gallery cache, and broadcasts `work.published` over `/ws/wall`.
Transitions a `Published` work to `Unpublished`, clears `is_featured`, invalidates Redis cache, and broadcasts `work.unpublished` over `/ws/wall`.

patch.description: Sets or clears `is_featured` on a `Published` work. Featuring a new work automatically clears the previous featured work in the same transaction.

409.description: Work is not Published (only Published works can be featured)
